steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Ballet is characterised by turnout, pointe work, elevation and precise classical technique | Key Fact: Contemporary dance blends ballet and modern techniques with an emphasis on floor work and weight | Key Fact: Jazz dance combines African rhythms, theatrical performance and syncopated, energetic movement | Key Fact: Hip-hop dance includes breaking, locking, popping and krumping, rooted in urban street culture

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from dance styles &amp; genres, and one past-paper question.
